newsitem.title: USA: Odwalla pulling juice off retail shelves.
newsitem.headline: Odwalla pulling juice off retail shelves.

text.p: Odwalla Inc has agreed to pull all its products off retail shelves in the Seattle area until further notice after an outbreak of bacterial disease tied to its fruit juice, government officials said Wednesday.

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has begun an investigation of Odwalla's production plant in California after the outbreak of E. coli disease was tied to Odwalla fruit juice, particularly unpasteurized fruit juice, Washington state and county officials said.

The government officials said in a statement that 10 out of 13 confirmed cases of E. coli in the Seattle area since last week had been traced to Odwalla juice, and the remaining cases were under investigation.
One health official said there were eight additional unconfirmed but suspected cases of E. coli in the current outbreak.
The outbreak so far has affected children and young adults aged 2 to 22. Several have required kidney dialysis and at least one remained hospitalized in satisfactory condition.
